Marquette was coached by [[Buzz Williams]] and played their home games at the [[BMO Harris Bradley Center]] in [[Milwaukee|Milwaukee, WI]] as were members of the [[Big East Conference (1979–2013)|Big East Conference]]. They finished the season 26–9, 14–4 in Big East play to earn a share of Big East Conference regular season championship. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2013 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]] against Cincinnati. The Golden Eagles received an at-large bid to the [[2013 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they defeated [[2012–13 Davidson Wildcats men's basketball team|Davidson]], [[2012–13 Butler Bulldogs men's basketball team|Butler]], and [[2012–13 Miami Hurricanes men's basketball team|Miami]], before losing to [[2012–13 Syracuse Orange men's basketball team|Syracuse]] in the Elite Eight. == Previous season == The [[2011–12 Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball team|Golden Eagles]] finished the [[2011–12 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2011–12 season]] 26–7, 14–4 in [[2011–12 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to finish in second place. [[2011–12 Syracuse Orange men's basketball team|Syracuse]], the winner of the Big East regular season, was later forced to vacate its wins from the season due to NCAA violations.{{Cite news|url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/syracuse-to-vacate-wins-lose-12-scholarships-boeheim-suspended/|title=Syracuse to vacate wins, lose 12 scholarships; Boeheim suspended|work=CBSSports.com|access-date=2018-02-21|language=en}} The Eagles received an at-large bid to the [[2012 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they defeated [[2011–12 BYU Cougars men's basketball team|BYU]] and [[2011–12 Murray State Racers men's basketball team|Murray State]] to advance to the Sweet Sixteen for the second consecutive year. There they lost to [[2011–12 Florida Gators men's basketball team|Florida]].{{Cite
